changelog: Major v1.4.0 release: 0-0-2 mini game is bundled directly into Pickle Que.
Direct upgrade path from v1.3.24; broken v1.3.25/v1.3.26 checksum path is skipped.
Public navigation is forced into one row: Home, Bookings, Queue, 0-0-2 and Settings.
Admin navigation is one row with Home, Bookings, Queue, 0-0-2, Calendar and Settings.
Public Settings can check and view System Update status; installation remains Admin-only for server security.
Public Bookings is date-first: open a date to see occupied time ranges, then request a slot with that date prefilled.
Existing queue rotation, editable On Deck, duplicate protection, match timing/history and PH time behavior are preserved.
